name: craft-context
description: Complete Knowledge, Memory, Experience, and Codebase tools in one Craft entry point

interface.shortDescription: One complete entry point for Craft Knowledge, Memory, Experience, and Codebase.
interface.longDescription: Expose the full supported Knowledge, Memory, Experience, and read-only Codebase MCP tool surfaces through one plugin. Context resolution still produces bounded receipts; Codebase operations remain explicit and snapshot-pinned. The plugin does not grant execution authority or silently import private chat history.
defaultPrompt: Use the Craft Context plugin as the complete entry point for Knowledge, Memory, Experience, and Codebase tools. Discover the relevant operation, preserve each component's evidence and safety gates, and use bounded context receipts when resolving project context.
